content:
Recently there was a commit that fixed a number of spelling mistakes found by "codespell":

https://github.com/leanprover/cslib/pull/538

How do I run "codespell" on cslib locally? I'm writing a lot of comments and would like to find my many spelling mistakes.
It is a Python library used from the command line: https://github.com/codespell-project/codespell
Any customization needed for Lean and/or cslib?
Hi, I’m the one that made that commit - I didn’t use any customization, but there will be false positives you should be aware of
